www.thermotec.com.authermotec.com.au customerservice@thermotec.com.au1300 727 083168 Carrington Street Revesby NSW 2212
A ﬂexible closed-cell EPDM elastomeric foam material suitable for Solar Systems 
and use on hot and chilled water lines with outstanding ultraviolet and weather 
resistance. This product is highly ﬂexible and provides a neat appearance when 
ﬁtted to exposed water lines. A homogeneous cell structure means that no 
external UV protection is required.
Material: EPDM closed cell foam
Density: 60kg/m3 nominal
Service Temperature: ASTM D 537:2004 -57°C to +150°C continuous (180C intermittent) 
Thermal Conductivity W/mK 0.036 @ 24°C
UV Resistance ISO 4892-2:2006 (No cracks present)
Weather Resistance Excellent
Flexibility Excellent
Flammability AS1530.3:1999 - BS476 parts 6&7 Class 0 
•Hot & cold water lines – general plumbing 
•Solar Hot Water – all application interior & exterior 
•Refrigeration 
•Air Conditioning 
•LP Steam & Condensate lines – up to 160°C 
•Exceeds BCA R-value requirements at appropriate WT 
•Emi-4: Insulant ODP (zero ozone depleting substances)
ISO 5660.1-2002 Group 2
AS1530.3:1999 
Ignitability 0 (range 0-20)
Spread of flame 0 (range 0-10)
Heat evolved 0 (range 0-10)
Smoke developed 5 (range 0-10)
E-flex HT is expected to have a service life in excess of 10 years against UV degradation. It is the customer's responsibility to determine if this product is fit for 
purpose, given the conditions of the intended application.
Specification Guidelines
Where solar system or other piping is exposed to the weather, Thermotec E-Flex HT weather-
resistant insulation shall be applied. The product must be of a wall thickness that meets or exceeds 
BCA/NCC requirements and AS/NZS 2712:2007.
